1、线索管理与调查：负责管理公司内部违规举报线索，对违反职场尊重、利益冲突、损害公平氛围等职业道德类违规案件进行独立、公正调查，通过专业的调查技巧和方法，收集和分析证据，输出完整规范的结论报告和处理方案，并平稳推动后续处置；
2、证据审查与执行：审查、核实廉洁舞弊、信息安全等案件的调查结论与证据材料，并依据公司政策及管理需求，提出最终处理意见，并妥善执行公司的最终决定；
3、风险识别与治理：通过案件汇总分析，能有效识别公司内部合规风险，站在管理视角，积极推动跨部门协作，输出切实可行的改进意见，解决系统或流程风险；
4、合规宣传贯彻与协作：参与内部合规项目协作，完善各项合规制度与工作流程，注重防范和化解职业道德及合规的相关风险；支持合规政策的宣传贯彻与培训，推广公司廉洁合规文化。
requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，法律专业优先；
2、3年以上律师、法官工作经验，或企业合规、调查、员工关系等相关工作经验；
3、优秀的逻辑思维和判断力、原则性强，能够对复杂事情有判断，有依据、高标准、强执行；
4、出色的沟通协调能力与多任务处理能力，能适应快节奏工作环境；
5、英语可作为工作语言者优先。

title: 大数据开发工程师（抖音电商） - 泛抖音
responsibilities:
团队介绍：负责字节跳动旗下泛抖音生态的数据 BP 工作，业务版图覆盖抖音主端、直播、电商、生活服务等板块。我们以数据高效赋能业务增长为核心使命，深度扎根各业务线，以数据体系建设为根基、以业务目标达成为导向，为业务方提供专业、稳定、高效的数据服务与架构解决方案。工作内容聚焦海量数据的治理与应用，需对产品全链路数据进行复杂且深度的分析挖掘；深度参与大数据产品的迭代优化，探索前沿数据技术在业务场景中的落地实践，在字节跳动的技术土壤中实现个人能力与业务价值的双重增长。

1、主导Agent核心能力与工作流的编排，将RAG、Tool Use、上下文管理等关键技术与大数据场景深度融合，为复杂任务提供精准、高效的自动化解决方案（如需求理解、智能SQL生成、自动发布、自动运维等）；
2、推动大模型应用落地，探索包括RAG-QA机器人、数据洞察机器人、AICoding等在真实场景的应用价值，并基于评估体系实现应用效果的持续迭代；
3、负责电商业务的离线与实时数据仓库构建、数据模型设计、ETL实施、性能优化、数据监控及技术问题解决，深入业务理解并抽象需求，与业务团队紧密合作以发挥数据价值，参与大数据应用规划及数据治理工作，提升数据易用性与数据质量。
requirements:
1、具备LLM应用工程能力者优先：熟悉RAG架构和实现，有检索实践经验；熟悉Prompt工程与Tool Use，理解其在Agent任务拆解与执行中的作用；具备良好的Python开发能力，能灵活运用于Skill等脚本开发；
2、熟悉数据仓库实施方法论、深入了解数据仓库体系，并支撑过实际业务场景；
3、熟练使用Hadoop及Hive，熟悉SQL、Java、Python等编程语言；
4、善于沟通，对业务敏感，能快速理解业务背景，具备优秀的技术与业务结合能力。

团队介绍：我们隶属于产品研发与工程架构部，是字节跳动在智能硬件领域的软件技术攻坚力量—— 聚焦 AI 与智能硬件的深度融合，如豆包手机助手等；以 “让人与设备的交互更自然、更便捷” 为目标，探索前沿 AI 技术的落地场景，打造行业领先的智能硬件综合解决方案。
在这里，你将与一支顶尖技术团队并肩：
- 直击 AI 与硬件结合的核心技术难题，参与从 “技术探索” 到 “场景落地” 的全链路研发；
- 主导或深度参与关键技术突破，用创新定义智能硬件的交互未来；
- 站在行业前沿，将技术理想转化为千万用户可感知的产品体验。
如果你心怀对技术的热忱，渴望在 AI 与智能硬件的赛道上突破自我、创造价值，我们期待你的加入，与我们一起解锁更多技术可能，共筑智能交互的新生态！

1、参与Agent Infra的建设，参与评测建设、AgenticSearch、知识库等基础能力建设，对大模型应用效果进行持续调优，通过数据分析与策略改进，提升工具的性能和体验；
2、构建多维评测框架，综合确定性校验、模型裁判与人工抽检的混合评估策略；建设回归测试与实验能力，为迭代效果提供量化保障；
3、构建「执行→反馈→分析→优化」的自进化闭环，通过轨迹分析自动识别薄弱环节，驱动上下文工程策略调优与能力自适应更新；
4、跟踪AI技术趋势，思考AI研发新范式、AI新技术在研发提效中的落地场景，驱动产品创新。
requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、人工智能等相关专业，硕士学位优先；
2、熟练掌握Python，同时熟悉Go/Nodejs/TypeScript中至少一门，具备良好的系统设计能力；
3、熟悉主流大模型的能力边界、API调用与Prompt工程实践；理解Agent Loop、ReAct、Plan-and-Execute等主流架构模式；
4、优秀的逻辑思维，善于将复杂场景拆解为可落地方案；
5、良好的沟通协作能力，认可团队的目标和文化，能和团队一起探索新技术，推进技术进步。

加分项
1、有Agent评测体系搭建经验，熟悉混合评估方法，或有LLM微调、模型评测经验；
2、有Agent自进化、数据飞轮系统设计经验，或上下文工程、分层记忆系统实践经验；
3、有Multi-Agent编排框架实际项目经验；
4、有RAG系统建设经验，熟悉向量检索与知识图谱，或熟悉MCP、Function Calling等工具集成协议；
5、有研发效能工具或AI Coding产品开发经验；
6、在Agent/LLM领域有开源贡献或论文发表。

Seed团队在AI领域拥有长期愿景与决心，团队研究方向涵盖MLLM、GenMedia、AI for Science、机器人等，在中国、新加坡、美国等地设有实验室和岗位。目前，团队已推出业界领先的通用大模型以及前沿的多模态能力，支持豆包、即梦、TRAE等超过50个应用场景，并通过火山引擎开放给企业客户。第三方数据显示，豆包App用户量在中国市场排名第一，豆包大模型日均Token调用量行业领先。

1、负责计算机视觉以及机器学习领域的前沿研究开发，尤其是AIGC领域（如图像、视频或3D生成）；

3、探索以人工智能技术为核心的新产品。
requirements:

4、发布顶会论文者优先，如CVPR、ECCV、ICCV、NeurIPS、ICLR、SIGGRAPH或SIGGRAPH Asia等。

1、本科及以上学历，5年以上电子硬件产品项目的多品类物料采购、订单交付、供应计划方面工作经验；
2、具备优秀的组织内外部沟通和协调能力、较强的执行力及自驱能力；
3、具备较好的项目管理技能、业务流程优化和系统逻辑运用能力；
4、具备一定的英语沟通能力，可作为工作语言。

title: 多模态算法工程师-搜索
responsibilities:
团队介绍：字节跳动搜索团队主要负责抖音、国际化短视频、今日头条、红果短剧、番茄小说、AI搜索等产品以及电商、生活服务等业务的搜索算法创新和架构研发工作。
我们使用前沿的机器学习\大模型技术进行端到端建模并不断创新突破，同时专注于分布式系统、机器学习系统的构建和性能优化，从内存、Disk等优化到索引压缩、召回、排序等算法的探索，致力于支撑字节跳动持续多元化的产品创新和高速的业务增长、基于大模型革新和重塑下一代搜索技术体系，充分给同学们提供成长自我的机会。
主要工作方向包括：
1、探索前沿的NLP技术：全面基于LLM的Query分析、相关性、个性化预估、满意度评估、生成式检索等，全链路应用LLM/VLM，每个细节都充满挑战；
2、跨模态匹配技术：进行多模态预训练，在超大规模的多模态表征、匹配、生成等多个技术方向上持续突破，打造世界领先的多模态搜索系统。
3、大规模流式机器学习技术：应用大规模机器学习，解决搜索中的推荐问题，让搜索更加个性化更加懂你；
4、千亿级数据规模的架构：从大规模离线计算，分布式系统的性能、调度优化，到构建高可用、高吞吐和低延迟的在线服务的方方面面都有深入研究和创新；
5、推荐技术：基于超大规模机器学习、因果推断、大模型推理等技术手段，构建业界领先的搜索推荐系统，对搜索推荐技术进行探索和创新。

1、多模态大模型：基于VLM、大规模对比学习、通用Tokenizer等模型研究与应用，为抖音短视频生态提供基础的高质量图文Caption、多模态表征、Tokenizer等，探索多模态大模型的Scaling Law；
2、AI问答/Agent：基于Continue Train、SFT、RL等训练技术迭代Planner、Summary提升工具使用、多媒体总结能力，探索Agentic技术升级；
3、大规模视觉搜索：相关性、召回排序、个性化建模等算法持续升级提升用户体验，探索自动化标注、生成式召回、召粗精一体化系统、多模态表征/个性化CoTrain、Dense个性化、RL Based GE混排等技术。
requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，基础扎实，有良好的代码、机器学习算法功底和经验；
2、熟悉CV、VLM、OmniModel、LLM、Agent、DeepResearch、视觉搜索/AI问答等相关的算法和技术；
3、出色的问题解决能力，善于分析，历史上解决过难题，遇到难题时能静下心，没有畏难情绪，能查到底层；
4、由衷热爱技术，可以一线写代码，查问题，有强烈的工作责任心，较好的学习能力、沟通能力和自驱力。

团队介绍：TikTok研发团队，旨在实现TikTok业务的研发工作，搭建及维护业界领先的产品。加入我们，你能接触到包括用户增长、社交、直播、电商C端、内容创造、内容消费等核心业务场景，支持产品在全球赛道上高速发展；也能接触到包括服务架构、基础技术等方向上的技术挑战，保障业务持续高质量、高效率、且安全地为用户服务；同时还能为不同业务场景提供全面的技术解决方案，优化各项产品指标及用户体验。 
在这里， 有大牛带队与大家一同不断探索前沿， 突破想象空间。 在这里，你的每一行代码都将服务亿万用户。在这里，团队专业且纯粹，合作氛围平等且轻松。目前在北京，上海，杭州、广州、深圳分别开放多个岗位机会。

1、负责算法质量管理、系统稳定性治理相关项目的整体推进，制定项目目标、里程碑和协同机制，确保重点事项按计划落地；在复杂项目中承担组织协调和推进角色，帮助团队提升协作效率、交付质量与稳定性水平；
2、与算法、研发、运维等多团队协作，推动跨团队需求对齐、风险识别、资源协调和问题闭环；
3、搭建和优化质量管理机制，包括但不限于测试准入、发布质量管控、变更风险治理、故障复盘、问题跟踪与持续改进；推动稳定性建设相关专项，围绕线上事故预防、质量度量、风险预警、故障归因和治理闭环建立长期机制；
4、建设项目与质量运营指标体系，沉淀可度量、可复盘、可持续优化的方法和流程，结合业务发展阶段，持续识别质量与稳定性瓶颈，推动平台化、机制化治理方案落地。
requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、通信、电子信息或相关专业优先；
2、具备较强的跨团队沟通与项目推进能力，能够推动多角色协同，协调依赖并达成共识；
3、对研发流程、测试流程、发布流程、质量保障或稳定性治理有较深入理解，能够识别风险并推动机制改进；
4、具备一定技术理解能力，能够与研发和算法团队进行高效沟通，理解系统架构、技术方案或质量风险场景；
5、具备结构化思考与问题拆解能力，能在复杂环境下推动项目落地；具备较强的数据意识和复盘意识，能够通过指标、流程和机制持续优化交付质量。

加分项
1、具备QA/QE/测试开发/SQA/质量管理/稳定性治理相关经验优先；或有从质量职能向项目管理、技术运营或治理岗位发展的意愿；
2、有算法平台、推荐/搜索/广告、机器学习平台或数据平台相关质量治理经验；
3、有线上稳定性治理、故障管理、发布管理、质量平台建设或工程效率提升经验；
4、有自动化测试平台、质量平台、监控平台或风险治理工具建设经验；
5、有复杂技术项目、跨部门专项或组织级流程优化项目推进经验；
6、有从QA/SQA成功转型为TPM、项目经理、质量项目负责人或稳定性负责人的经历。

title: 大模型算法专家/工程师（代码智能方向）-TRAE
responsibilities:

1、负责代码场景的效果优化，深入研究LLM后训练等相关技术，提高算法准确率和效率；
2、分析业务需求，设计并实现适用于不同场景的算法解决方案，支持产品线在算法方面的需求；
3、持续跟进LLM前沿技术，基于LLM完成在代码领域中的复杂任务。
requirements:
1、硕士及以上学位，计算机、软件工程、人工智能等相关专业；
2、具有数据建设、指令微调和模型建设经验，具备优秀的代码能力、数据结构和基础算法功底；
3、熟悉大模型训练、RL算法者优先；在大模型领域，主导过有影响力的项目或论文者优先；
4、出色的问题分析和解决能力，能深入解决大模型训练和应用存在的问题；
5、良好的沟通协作能力，能和团队一起探索新技术，推进技术进步。

responsibilities:

4、有大模型应用开发经验的优先。

title: 机器学习系统调度研发工程师-Data AML
responsibilities:

1、负责机器学习系统资源调度的设计和开发，服务于各方向场景（NLP/CV/Speech等）的模型训练、模型评估和模型推理；
2、负责多种异构资源（GPU、CPU、其他异构硬件）的最优化编排，实现稳定资源、潮汐资源、混布资源、多云资源的合理化使用；

4、负责多机房、多地域、多云场景的在离线任务/服务调度，实现负载合理化分布。
requirements:
1、熟练掌握Linux环境下的Go/Python/Shell等1至2种以上语言；
2、熟悉Kubernetes架构和生态，熟悉Docker/Containerd/Kata/Podman等容器技术，有丰富的机器学习系统实践和开发经验；
3、掌握分布式系统原理，参与过大规模分布式系统的设计、开发和维护；
4、有优秀的逻辑分析能力，能够对业务逻辑进行合理的抽象和拆分；
5、有强烈的工作责任心，较好的学习能力、沟通能力和自驱力，能够快速的响应和行动。

加分项：
1、熟悉至少一种主流的机器学习框架（TensorFlow/PyTorch）；
2、有以下某一方向领域的经验：AI Infrastructure，HW/SW Co-Design，High Performance Computing，ML Hardware Architecture（GPU、Accelerators、Networking）。

title: Research Engineer - LLM/VLM Inference Optimization (Seed Infra)
responsibilities:
About the Team
The Seed Infrastructures team oversees the distributed training, reinforcement learning framework, high-performance inference, and heterogeneous hardware compilation technologies for AI foundation models.

Responsibilities
1. Design, develop, and optimize high-performance inference systems for large-scale LLMs and VLMs, covering inference engines, serving frameworks, and end-to-end deployment pipelines.
2. Build state-of-the-art model inference engines through advanced performance optimization techniques such as compiler-level optimizations, parallel computing, graph fusion, efficient CUDA kernel development, low-precision computation, streaming inference, speculative decoding, and high-concurrency request optimization. 
3. Collaborate closely with other research teams to identify performance bottlenecks, conduct in-depth performance analysis, and optimize large models; contribute to the development of model toolchains and the broader technical ecosystem.
requirements:

- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.

- Experience deploying or optimizing LLM/VLM inference at production scale, with demonstrated impact on latency, throughput, or serving cost.
- Familiarity with GPU architecture and experience optimizing compute-intensive operators (e.g., FlashAttention, GEMM, GEMV, Conv2D).

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with large-scale LLM serving infrastructure or equivalent production LLM deployment experience.
- Experience in GPU programming (CUDA/OpenCL) and familiarity with frameworks such as TensorRT, Triton, or CUTLASS.

- Familiarity with model/data parallelism frameworks for distributed inference.

responsibilities:
团队介绍：字节跳动抖音搜索团队主要负责抖音搜索算法创新和架构研发工作，主要包括短视频、直播、本地生活、视觉搜索等多个业务线。我们使用最前沿的机器学习技术进行端到端建模并不断创新突破，同时专注于分布式系统、机器学习系统的构建和性能优化，从内存、Disk等优化到索引压缩、召回、排序等算法的探索，充分给同学们提供成长自我的机会。主要工作方向包括：1、探索前沿的NLP技术：从基础的分词、NER，到应用上的Query分析、基础相关性等，全链路应用深度学习模型，每个细节都充满挑战；2、跨模态匹配技术：在搜索中应用CV+NLP深度学习技术，让视频搜索拥有更强大的检索能力；3、大规模流式机器学习技术：应用大规模机器学习，解决搜索中的推荐问题，让搜索更加个性化更加懂你；4、千亿级数据规模的架构：从大规模离线计算，分布式系统的性能、调度优化，到构建高可用、高吞吐和低延迟的在线服务的方方面面都有深入研究和创新。

具体负责：
1、参与抖音搜索的核心算法改进工作：用最先进的NLP、CV、CTR预估等技术不断提高搜索结果的精度，持续提升用户的搜索体验 ；
2、可能的方向包括：
1）匹配技术（文本匹配和多模匹配）：匹配技术是搜索引擎的核心。在抖音搜索，你将有机会应用最前沿的NLP和CV技术为每一个query匹配最相关的视频，持续提升抖音搜索的相关性 ；

4、熟悉Linux开发环境，熟练使用C++和Python语言；
5、有搜索算法经验者加分。

title: Model Safety Analyst - AI Data & Safety
responsibilities:
The AI Data and Safety team plays a critical role in advancing Seed's foundational models, AI products across modalities, and improving AI-native applications built on the Seed model series. We work across the data lifecycle, from defining evaluation approaches, translating user feedback and benchmark outcomes into data requests, to building scalable processes that improve data quality and support rapid model iteration.

Our team combines technical and operational capabilities, bringing together multidisciplinary and multilingual talent across product management, data engineering, and data operations. Our work is driven by people who think deeply about model behavior, move quickly to solve complex problems, and bring first-hand experience as both builders and users of models and agents.

In close partnership with internal researchers, industry experts, and leading data vendors, we tackle challenging data problems at the frontier of AI development, helping improve both model performance and user experience.

Our team is dedicated to ensuring the safe and ethical development of Seed models by proactively identifying, monitoring, and mitigating risks. Our comprehensive approach includes safety evaluation, safety training, and policy research. We conduct thorough evaluations and red-teaming exercises on Seed models (LLM, VLM, Audio, and Multimodal models) using real-world scenarios to identify and mitigate potential risks.  In parallel, we provide hands-on safety training to enhance model behavior and refine our AI safety policy to address emerging risks and ensure compliance with global and regional standards. Ultimately, we drive the development of more responsible AI technologies across the Seed and AI Data & Safety departments.

Your Role Will Involve:
- Conduct research on the latest developments in AI safety across academia and industry. Proactively identify limitations in existing evaluation paradigms and propose novel, defensible approaches to test and evaluate models under real-world and edge-case scenarios.
- Design and continuously refine safety evaluation guidelines for multi-models. Define and implement robust evaluation metrics to assess safety-related behaviors, failure modes, and alignment with responsible AI principles.
- Conduct thorough analyses of safety evaluation results to surface safety issues stemming from model training, fine-tuning, or product integration. Translate these findings into actionable insights to inform model iteration and product design improvements.
- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to build scalable safety evaluation workflows. Help establish feedback loops that continuously inform model development and risk mitigation strategies, and work closely with other operations teams to ensure high-quality, safety-aligned judgments, evaluation outcomes, and synthesized training data.
- Manage end-to-end project lifecycles, including scoping, planning, execution, and delivery. Effectively allocate team resources and coordinate efforts across functions to meet project goals and timelines.
- Continuously innovate on the creation and design of new automated workflows and methodologies that ensure scalability, efficiency, and coverage within safety contexts, including for safety policy research, safety data generation, data analysis, and evaluation framework validation purposes.

Please note that this role may involve exposure to potentially harmful or sensitive content, either as a core function, through ad hoc project participation, or via escalated cases. This may include, but is not limited to, text, images, or videos depicting:
- Hate speech or harassment
- Self-harm or suicide-related content
- Violence or cruelty 
- Child safety
Support resources and resilience training will be provided to support employee well-being.
requirements:
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in AI Policy, Public Policy, Political Science, International Relations, Law, Philosophy, or a related discipline.
- Strong command of English in both written and oral communication. 
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret both qualitative and quantitative data and translate them into clear insights.
- Proven project management abilities, with experience leading cross-functional initiatives in dynamic, fast-paced environments.
- Creative problem-solving mindset, with comfort working under ambiguity and leveraging tools and technology to improve processes and outputs.

Preferred Qualifications
- Professional experience in AI safety, Trust & Safety, Risk consulting, or Risk management. Experience working at or with AI companies is highly desirable.
- Prior experience building scalable, automated workflows, including hands-on experience with prompt engineering, agent skills, and automated data generation pipelines. 
- Intellectually curious, self-motivated, detail-oriented, and team-oriented.
- Deep interest in emerging technologies, user behavior, and the human impact of AI systems. Enthusiasm for learning from real-world case studies and applying insights in a high-impact setting.
- Technical background that aids in the designing of automated workflows (e.g., coding) or technical knowledge of generative AI technologies are advantageous but not essential.

title: Head of Compliance, Southeast Asia - Global Payment
responsibilities:
About the team

Global Payment Compliance sits within Global Payment. We build a world-class regulatory compliance team, systems, and controls to proactively mitigate regulatory risks and enable business growth through sound compliance framework implementation and license acquisitions. 

About the Role
We are looking for a senior compliance leader to serve as Head of Compliance, Southeast Asia for our payments and financial services business. This role leads the regional compliance agenda across Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines, Malaysia, and Indonesia. This role does not cover Singapore.

The role is responsible for shaping a strong, scalable compliance framework across diverse regulatory environments while enabling sustainable business growth. The successful candidate will partner closely with business, legal, risk, product, operations and public policy teams to support market expansion, product development, governance, and regulatory engagement across SEA.

This individual will play a key role in leading regulator-facing engagement and ensuring the company maintains a credible, proactive, and well-governed compliance posture in each market. Key regulatory counterparts may include the Bank of Thailand, Bank Negara Malaysia, Suruhanjaya Kredit Pengguna (Consumer Credit Commission, SKP), State Bank of Vietnam, Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, SEC, OJK, and Bank Indonesia, depending on the company’s business model, product suite, and licensing footprint. This role reports to the Head of Compliance, Global Payment.

Responsibilities

Regional Compliance Leadership and Compliance Framework Implementation
- Lead the compliance strategy, governance, and oversight model for Southeast Asia across Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines, Malaysia, and Indonesia.
- Serve as senior advisor to regional and country leadership on strategic initiatives, new business models, market expansion, partnerships and product developments.
- Build and maintain a scalable regional compliance framework (AML/CFT, Sanctions, consumer protection, data security and privacy, etc) that balances consistency in standards with market-specific regulatory requirements.
- Ensure effective compliance coverage across payments and financial services activities, including licensing obligations, conduct and consumer protection expectations, regulatory reporting, complaints governance and financial crime coordination.

Regulatory Engagement and Policy Interpretation
- Lead and coordinate regulatory engagement with relevant financial regulators and supervisory stakeholders across Southeast Asia.
- Act as a principal contact for regulatory interactions, including licensing matters, supervisory inquiries, inspections, regulatory reviews, thematic assessments, and remediation discussions.
- Support the business in maintaining trusted relationships with regulators including authorities such as Bank of Thailand, Bank Negara Malaysia, SKP, State Bank of Vietnam, Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, SEC, OJK, and Bank Indonesia.
- Interpret emerging legal and regulatory developments and translate them into practical business requirements, governance expectations and control enhancements.
- Help shape regional positions on regulatory change affecting payments, e-money, payment systems, intermediary payment services, outsourcing, operational resilience, safeguarding-related requirements and consumer protection.

Advisory and Product Compliance
- Advise business, product and operations teams on regulatory permissibility and compliance implications of new products, features, channels, partnerships and operating model changes.
- Provide actionable compliance guidance on payments and financial services activities such as merchant acquiring, stored value, remittance, payment facilitation, digital financial services, and related regulated activities.
- Promote compliance-by-design principles within product development, onboarding, servicing, and operational workflows.

Governance, Monitoring, and Issue Management
- Oversee compliance governance mechanisms, including policies and procedures, compliance risk assessments, monitoring plans, training programs, management information, and governance reporting.
- Identify, assess, escalate and manage material compliance risks across the region, and ensure timely remediation of control gaps and regulatory findings.
- Partner with internal stakeholders on incidents, investigations, complaints themes, audits, remediation plans and regulatory submissions.
- Ensure local regulatory obligations are reflected in regional and global frameworks, controls, and reporting structures.

Leadership and Stakeholder Management
- Build, lead, and develop a high-performing SEA compliance team.
- Partner effectively with Legal, Risk, AML, Internal Audit, Product, Operations, Government Relations, and senior business leadership.
- Influence senior stakeholders through strong judgment, clear communication, and deep understanding of regional regulatory expectations.
requirements:
Minimum Qualifications:
- Significant experience in compliance, regulatory affairs, legal, or related control functions within payments, fintech, banking, e-money, or broader financial services.
- Demonstrated experience leading compliance programs across multiple Southeast Asian markets.
- Strong track record of direct engagement with regulators, including supervisory dialogue, licensing support, inspections, thematic reviews, and remediation management.
- Experience advising fast-growing, technology-enabled businesses in regulated environments, and ability to operate effectively across complex, matrixed, and cross-border organizations.
- Strong working knowledge of regulatory frameworks relevant to payments and financial services across Southeast Asia.
- Excellent judgment and a pragmatic approach to balancing regulatory rigor with business enablement.
- Demonstrated people leadership and team development capability.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with licensing, regulatory change, and compliance framework build-out in one or more of the following markets: Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines, Malaysia, and Indonesia.
- Familiarity with AML/CFT, sanctions, conduct risk, consumer protection, complaints handling, outsourcing, third-party risk, and operational resilience requirements in regulated financial services environments.
- Legal qualification or advanced degree in law, finance, public policy, or a related field is a plus.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience preparing materials for regulators and senior executives.
- Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, manage multiple priorities, and execute across several jurisdictions simultaneously.
- High integrity, strong ownership mindset, and resilience in a fast-moving environment.

团队介绍：字节跳动基础设施DCE【Data Center Engineering】团队，负责字节跳动全球数据中心的技术支撑和CN自建&合建数据中心的建设交付。职责涵盖数据中心选址、规划设计、技术选型、交付管理、成本管理的全链条实现，同时从技术侧保障数据中心实现高可用、高可靠、高效率的稳定运行。致力于实现新一代数据中心技术可靠性与先进性双突破，同时推进高性价比、高可靠性数据中心园区建设。

1、负责字节跳动自建数据中心项目投资估算、设计概算、施工图预算编制；负责编制合约规划及资金使用计划；参与各阶段设计方案经济性评审，并从成本角度提出优化方案，为前期方案比选提供成本评估及建议；
2、负责根据投资估算及项目方案编制目标成本，并动态对项目全成本进行有效管控及持续优化；负责对各类设计变更、洽商及现场签证进行测算及审核；
3、协同参与项目各标段（如土建总包、机电分包、精装修分包、智能化分包、变电站EPC等）招标采购及成本管控工作，并负责部门主导的甲供设备、专业分包（如动环、BA、液冷等）等工程量清单、预算控制价编制、商务清标、评标、合同签订等；
4、负责项目全过程成本管控，协同编制项目整体结算计划，参与结算谈判及最终结算价审定；
5、负责对已交付项目进行经济后评估及成本指标总结与分析，负责行业成本对标及动态信息调研。
requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，工程造价、土木工程、工程管理、给排水、暖通、电气专业优先，3年以上数据中心行业造价、成本管理相关经验；
2、熟悉数据中心行业动态发展信息，熟悉各类数据中心技术架构、成本特点与指标及各种设备材料市场价格信息；
3、熟练编制及审核数据中心项目预结算，熟悉预算定额及工程量清单计价体系；
4、具备第三方数据中心行业园区IDC项目全过程成本工作经验者优先；
5、具备良好的自驱力与学习能力，优秀的沟通能力、组织协调与项目推动能力；英语可作为工作语言者优先。

title: 资深开放平台产品经理（资金平台）-TikTok
responsibilities:
1、负责参与构建公司下一代企业级资金与商业化SaaS平台，致力于提升商业化产品研发团队的整体开发效能，目标是抽象底层业务复杂度，提供标准化、高可用的中台服务支撑，通过主导全局统一的SKU架构设计与API接入标准制定，大幅降低各业务线（如直播、会员、虚拟资产等）的系统接入成本，赋能前台业务线实现商业模式的快速落地与迭代；
2、中台标准制定与业务接入规范：
1）API标准与规范设计：负责商业化中台核心API、Webhook及SDK的产品设计与规划，确保系统接口具备良好的幂等性（Idempotency）、版本控制机制与高扩展性；
2）业务接入体验优化：制定清晰、标准化的系统接入规范与开发者文档（Developer Portal），持续优化业务方的接入流程，缩短新业务的系统集成周期，提升整体交付效率；
3）自助化配置中心建设：设计高可用、多租户（Multi-tenant）的配置中心与规则引擎，支持业务或运营团队通过后台配置（如定价策略、分发渠道等）实现策略的直接应用，提升系统SaaS化水平及运营效率；
3、统一SKU与虚拟资产架构设计：
1）系统抽象与数据建模：负责搭建全局统一的虚拟商品与SKU管理底层架构，将复杂的定制化商品需求抽象为标准化、高复用的数据模型（Data Models）与状态机（State Machines），避免重复建设与系统强耦合；
2）虚拟资产全生命周期管理：负责跨业务线的虚拟资产管理，涵盖SKU创建、多币种定价（Multi-currency Pricing）、库存及有效期管理，以及“充值-消耗”模型（Wallet/Credits）的底层流转逻辑；
3）架构演进与系统重构：参与历史遗留业务系统的平滑迁移与架构重构规划，清晰界定底层SKU中心与上层业务系统的逻辑边界，在保障业务连续性的前提下，逐步降低系统技术债；
4、全球财税与合规底层产品化：
1）协同财务、税务及法务团队，在SKU与订单流转环节中嵌入合规校验与税务处理能力，为虚拟资产设计标准的税务编码体系（Tax Codes），支持系统自动适配各国家/地区的VAT/GST及数字服务税（DST）规则，实现前端业务线合规能力的标准化调用。
requirements:
1、专业经验：
1）3年以上互联网产品经理经验，具备开放平台、API产品、SaaS底层系统或电商后台（尤其是商品/SKU中心）的核心模块设计经验；
2）具备主导或作为核心成员参与跨部门复杂系统解耦、架构重构，或推动建立内部系统接入标准的实战案例；
2、领域知识：
1）系统抽象能力：能够穿透定制化的业务表象，提炼底层共性逻辑；深入理解底层数据模型及状态流转机制；
2）技术理解力：具备良好的技术认知，能够与架构师/研发团队顺畅探讨系统边界划分、API设计规范（如RESTful/GraphQL协议）、并发限流及数据一致性等底层架构议题；
3）业务理解：熟悉创作者经济（Creator Economy）商业模式、虚拟商品生命周期及主流平台变现机制；
3、综合素质：
1）需求优先级把控：具备清晰的系统边界感与优先级管理能力；在面对多业务线复杂的定制化诉求时，能有效平衡短期业务交付目标与长期平台架构的通用性；
2）跨团队协同与推动力：具备优秀的横向沟通与项目管理能力，能够在矩阵化组织架构中，推动多个诉求各异的业务线和研发团队达成共识并落地实施。

团队介绍：国际商业化产品与技术团队支持字节跳动国际短视频业务的广告产品与变现技术，我们负责end2end的大型广告系统建设，为客户提供商业推广方式与方案，覆盖字节跳动所有国际化用户产品，目前已在美国、加拿大、新加坡、欧洲、中东等国家和区域开展业务。我们的愿景是建立服务全球广告主的综合数字化营销服务平台，打造一体化广告平台，建联广告主、创作者及用户。在这里你将有机会开阔自己的国际化视野，接触到全球领先的商业产品架构、模型和算法，并有机会参与并推动互联网广告行业的创新和变革。

1、负责国际化产品信息流广告的流量策略设计，包括策略设计、实验设计和数据分析；
2、有用户视角，能够不断挖掘机会点持续优化用户体验，实现商业化收入增长和用户体验保护的平衡；
3、和算法工程师合作，优化流量分发框架，提升广告流量分发效率；
4、协调多团队合作，结果导向推动项目成功。
requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，3年以上互联网广告相关工作经验；
2、有敏锐的数据和用户洞察力，逻辑性强，善于通过数据解决问题；
3、有较好的跨部门协作能力，有团队合作精神和较强自驱力；
4、对广告竞价机制有全面的了解，能够通过问题看到本质，提供解决方案；
5、办公地点可为北京、上海、深圳。

4、探索前瞻性设计，积极创新，提升产品生命力。
requirements:

2、具备产品设计全栈能力以及丰富的3D视觉表现能力，较高的设计认知与坚持，良好的逻辑思维能力，独立跟进及方案验证能力，提供创新完整方案；
3、高度重视设计细节，对业界或相关领域的产品设计敏感洞察；
4、具备良好的抗压能力、学习能力、问题解决能力和创新能力。

title: 资深安全攻防工程师-生活服务
responsibilities:

2、对抖音生活服务相关应用及APP产品做漏洞挖掘、风险治理，并对重点项目进行安全保障与支持；
3、参与SDLC安全体系及流程建设及优化，在设计开发阶段前置规避潜在安全风险，从架构层系统化解决安全风险；
4、负责安全评估、代码审计、渗透测试、漏洞挖掘、攻防演练等安全相关能力建设及流程建设，与产品研发团队紧密合作推动业务安全水位提升。
requirements:
1、熟悉常见攻击方式和防御措施，包括漏洞及漏洞成因、渗透思路和方法；
2、能主动关注国内外最新安全攻防技术，并在自己擅长和兴趣的领域能够进行深入的学习、研究；
3、有快速学习、分析和解决问题的能力及了解事物原理的习惯；
4、具备良好的团队沟通、协作能力、良好的职业道德；
5、熟悉并掌握以下一种或多种技术领域的安全专业知识，如应用安全、数据安全、隐私合规、架构安全等。

title: 物流采购经理
responsibilities:
1、采购策略规划：结合企业业务特点与需求，制定全面的物流采购整体策略，确保物流服务商能够高效运作，有力支持业务的快速发展；
2、供应商管理：主导物流供应商的筛选、评估与合作全流程，建立并维护优质供应商资源库，监督供应商在运输各环节的服务质量与效率；
3、成本精准把控：深入了解物流行业仓储、干线运输、配送成本构成，运用专业的成本分析方法，制定合理的采购预算，严格控制物流采购成本，在保障物流服务质量的前提下，实现成本的最优化；
4、合同管理：负责拟定详细、严谨的物流采购合同，明确双方权利义务，特别是服务标准、费用结算、违约责任等关键条款，全程监督合同执行情况，确保合同有效履行；
5、协调沟通：与内部各协同部门及外部物流供应商保持密切、顺畅的沟通协调，及时处理物流过程中出现的各类问题，保障业务的正常运转。
requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，物流管理、供应链管理、采购管理等相关专业优先；
2、拥有3年及以上国内电商平台物流采购管理工作经验，具备丰富的供应商管理和成本控制成功案例，熟悉电商物流运作模式者优先；
3、掌握扎实的物流管理和采购管理知识体系，熟悉国内电商物流采购流程，具备丰富的合同管理经验和高超的谈判技巧和能力；
4、具备卓越的沟通协作能力，能够与不同部门和供应商进行高效沟通；拥有优秀的目标管理、策略分析与解读及项目交付能力，具备强烈的责任心与主人翁意识；
5、具备精细化运营思维，能够深入分析物流数据，具备较强的逻辑分析能力和结构化总结能力，为物流采购决策提供有力支持；
6、拥有较强的抗压能力；善于学习新知识、新技能，并对行业新趋势保持敏锐的洞察力与好奇心；英语可作为工作语言进行商务沟通者优先。

title: 酒旅大促策略运营-TikTok生活服务
responsibilities:
1、负责酒旅业务的营销策略制定和落地，包括酒店、旅游、目的地服务等相关业务场景；根据业务目标制定用户增长、交易转化、复购提升等营销方案，推动GMV、订单量、用户活跃和转化率增长；
2、负责补贴策略设计与优化，包括优惠券、满减、折扣、平台补贴、商家联合补贴等，提升补贴使用效率和业务ROI；结合用户分层、消费场景、商家供给和市场竞争情况，制定差异化营销和补贴方案；
3、负责营销活动的数据分析和效果复盘，跟踪活动转化率、核销率、ROI、用户留存、GMV拉动等核心指标，并持续优化策略；关注酒旅行业趋势、用户需求变化和产品动态，沉淀可复制的营销增长方法论；
4、与产品团队协作，推动营销工具、活动机制、转化链路等产品能力优化；协同产品、运营、销售、数据、内容及区域团队，推动跨团队项目落地，确保业务目标达成；
5、负责重点营销项目的策划和执行，包括节假日活动、大促、目的地营销、品牌联合、达人合作等。
requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，市场营销、商业分析、经济学、统计学等相关专业优先；
2、具备营销、增长、产品运营或商业运营经验，有酒旅、OTA、本地生活、电商、内容平台经验者优先，理解用户转化路径、营销工具和平台产品逻辑，能够与产品团队高效协作推动需求落地；
3、具备补贴策略相关经验，熟悉优惠券、折扣、满减、平台补贴等玩法，能够独立完成策略设计、预算测算和效果评估；
4、精通数据分析，具备较强的数据敏感度和逻辑分析能力，能够基于数据发现问题、拆解原因并提出解决方案，熟悉Excel、SQL、BI等数据工具，有活动复盘、漏斗分析、用户分层、ROI分析经验者优先；
5、英文能力优秀，能够使用英文进行日常沟通、会议讨论、方案撰写和跨区域协作，具备较强的项目管理能力和跨团队沟通能力，能够推动复杂项目落地；
6、结果导向，具备较强的责任心、执行力和业务敏感度。

加分项：
1、有APAC、东南亚或印尼市场经验优先；
2、有TikTok、内容电商或达人营销平台经验优先；
3、有酒店集团、OTA、旅游平台或本地生活平台经验优先；
4、有营销活动、大促或目的地营销项目经验优先。

4、具备多团队复杂协作经验，可独立落地跨团队复杂项目，能自驱拿到结果。

1、制定质量治理策略与中长期能力规划：基于业务质量目标、模型训练效果和线上应用反馈，统筹制定质量治理的整体工作规划，明确团队在质量运营、执行标准运营、申诉处理等方向的职责边界与阶段目标；结合模型能力演进和业务发展节奏，规划团队在质量策略建设、质量诊断、问题归因、规则沉淀与闭环运营上的能力升级路径；
2、负责质量运营体系建设与执行标准落地，持续迭代人审与模型质量策略：基于治理要求，建立覆盖策略制定、执行、复盘、迭代的质量运营机制，推动质量要求从经验判断转化为可量化、可追踪、可复用的管理标准；围绕质量治理相关作业场景，建立并持续维护SOP、执行手册、质量口径、判定标准和协作流程，确保团队在不同业务、不同场景下具备统一且可执行的工作标准；通过标准培训、过程抽检、案例复盘和版本管理，推动执行标准从文档要求转化为团队稳定动作，提升跨角色协同效率、过程可控性与结果一致性；
3、负责申诉处理机制建设与复杂问题闭环治理：统筹质量申诉场景的规则设计、流转机制、判定标准和处理时效要求，建立覆盖受理、研判、复核、反馈、复盘的闭环机制，保障申诉处理公平、准确、可追溯；针对高频争议问题、复杂边界案例和反复出现的异常场景，推动申诉结果反哺质量策略、执行标准与培训机制，持续降低重复性问题和系统性争议；
4、推动跨团队协同与质量问题治理机制建设：与算法、产品、策略、机审、标注、数据治理、测试及平台团队保持紧密协作，建立围绕质量问题发现、责任归因、策略优化、流程修订和效果验证的协同机制；能够将业务侧质量诉求、模型侧能力变化和执行侧实际问题进行整合判断，推动形成可落地的治理方案，确保质量目标在跨团队链路中被有效承接和执行；
5、负责团队管理与质量治理能力建设：根据业务场景复杂度和团队工作重点，设计合理的组织分工、岗位配置与目标管理机制，确保方向有明确负责人、关键项目有清晰节奏、重点问题有稳定跟进；对团队成员开展目标拆解、过程辅导、案例复盘和能力培养，持续提升团队在质量判断、策略运营、标准建设、申诉治理和跨部门协作上的整体水平，打造高标准、高透明度、结果导向的质量治理团队。
requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，3年以上质量管理、内容质量、内容质量管控运营、策略运营、模型训练数据运营工作经验，具备2年及以上团队管理经验；有大模型、人审质量、数据标注、质量策略建设等相关背景者优先；
2、具备较强的质量管理体系建设能力，能够围绕人审质量场景、模型中心策略、高质量样本保障、存量策略优化等方向，独立完成目标拆解、策略设计、机制搭建与迭代推进；熟悉SOP、执行标准、质量规范、申诉流程等管理机制，能够把复杂规则沉淀为可执行、可培训、可复盘的标准体系，并推动团队稳定落地；
3、具备较强的数据敏感度与问题分析能力，能够基于质量结果、申诉数据、抽检结果、策略命中情况等信息建立监控与复盘机制，识别关键问题并推动策略和流程持续优化；
4、具备优秀的跨部门沟通与协同推动能力，能够在算法、产品、运营、机审、标注、测试等多团队协作环境下清晰表达判断依据，推动复杂问题达成共识并形成落地方案；
5、具备成熟的团队管理与人才培养意识，能够通过培训、复盘、绩效牵引和机制建设提升团队专业能力与责任意识；同时具备较强的结果导向、细节把控能力和持续学习能力。

title: AI数据运营专家（视觉生成） - AI数据与安全
responsibilities:
团队介绍：AI 数据与安全团队为 Seed 基座模型及 AI 原生应用提供跨模态数据服务，覆盖数据生产全流程，包含模型评估标准的制定、数据规模化生产、数据飞轮搭建，不断提升数据质量，支持模型快速迭代。
团队由产品经理、数据工程、数据运营等跨职能人才组成，并通过与 Seed 研究员、行业专家、全球顶尖数据供应商紧密合作，从真实场景中收集反馈并分析模型表现数据，解决 AI 前沿突破过程中的复杂数据问题，推动模型性能与用户体验的双重提升。我们既是帮助模型技术迭代的一线贡献者，也是模型和 AI 产品的一手用户。

1、负责AI数据项目的整体统筹与推进，结合业务目标拆解需求，制定项目方案，协调数据、运营等多方资源，保障项目高质量、高效率交付；
2、负责重点项目全流程统筹，协调产品、数据、运营等多方资源，把控项目节奏及关键节点，及时协调解决项目推进过程中的问题，持续优化跨团队协作机制和项目管理流程；
3、负责数据团队日常运营管理，包括人员规划、人力分配、质量管理、根据业务特点持续优化团队协作效率；
4、建立并维护业务数据看板及项目分析体系，持续跟踪交付效率、质量及资源使用情况，通过数据分析发现问题并推动业务优化；
5、持续关注GenAI、大模型及AI Agent等前沿技术发展，积极探索Agent、Workflow等工具在数据生产、项目管理及协作场景中的应用，推动团队效率持续提升。
requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，影视制作、导演、制片、管理等相关专业优先，具备AI内容生产或GenAI相关项目经验者优先；
2、热爱影视创作及AI内容行业，对GenAI、大模型、AI Agent等技术保持持续关注，具备较强的学习能力和学习意愿，能够快速理解新工具并应用于实际项目；
3、具备优秀的项目统筹与制片能力，能够合理规划项目节奏、资源及人员安排，推动复杂项目高质量交付；
4、具备良好的跨团队沟通能力，高效推进项目落地；
5、具备一定的团队管理意识，能够进行人员管理、任务分配、团队协作及能力培养，根据业务需求完成资源协调与人力规划；
6、具备基础的数据分析能力，能够通过项目数据、质量指标及业务数据看板发现问题，推动项目持续优化。

title: 线索广告策略运营-抖音生活服务

2、产品行业适配运营：深度理解巨量引擎商业化广告产品的定位、底层逻辑、能力边界，结合行业业态、商家真实经营现状和生意需求，制定行业专属的产品渗透策略、落地运营打法与节奏，提升线索广告产品在行业内的渗透率、收入；
3、产品反向迭代推进：根据行业共性的生意链路，挖掘行业对商业化产品未覆盖、未满足的需求，联动上游产品团队输出行业侧信息，推动产品功能、计费模式、投放策略、后台流程的迭代优化，适配行业个性化经营需求；
4、跨业务协同落地：联动业务销售团队，对齐行业机会和增收策略、阶段目标、执行落地节奏；协同业务团队落地执行，解决业务收入卡点，保障业务统一推进和收入目标达成。
requirements:
1、岗位经验匹配：2年及以上的商业化产品运营、行业运营、KA客户运营全职经验，有广告商业化、商家经营变现、行业投放运营相关从业履历，有平台广告行业运营经验优先；
2、行业能力匹配：具备独立行业研究能力，可自主拆解行业趋势、商家盈利模式、成本结构、投放决策逻辑，精准甄别行业可撬动广告预算、投放机会，具备数据拆解、业态调研能力；
3、产品理解力匹配：具备一定基础的产品认知，能读懂产品设计初衷、业务流转逻辑、平台规则体系；可结合行业现状定制落地渗透策略，具备独立输出业务需求、反向推动产品迭代优化的实操经验。

title: AI搜索策略产品经理-小荷健康
responsibilities:

从互联网、高科技、消费零售到制造、金融、医疗健康，各行各业先进企业都在飞书落地AI，与飞书共创行业最佳实践。先进团队，AI用飞书。

title: Tech Lead, Research Scientist - DPU & AI Infra
responsibilities:
About the Team
The ByteDance DPU (Data Processing Unit) team is building the foundational computing infrastructure for ByteDance and Volcano Engine Public Cloud. Our mission is to advance the architecture, development, and research of next-generation software-hardware technologies across compute, networking, and storage for cloud and AI computing.  Our technology stack spans
- Cloud virtualization & hypervisors
- High-performance user-space network protocols (DPDK, RDMA, etc.)
- High-speed interconnect and virtual switching
- Distributed storage acceleration
- GPU virtualization and scheduling for AI/ML workloads
We work at the intersection of software systems, distributed infrastructure, and custom hardware acceleration, shaping the next wave of cloud-scale computing.

Responsibilities
- Design and develop DPU network software with a focus on high performance, low latency, and reliability.
- Collaborate with hardware teams to build software-hardware co-design solutions for networking and storage acceleration.
- Explore AI/ML infrastructure acceleration, leveraging DPUs, GPUs, and custom hardware to optimize distributed training and inference.
- Drive end-to-end performance optimization, from OS kernels and drivers to user-space runtime systems.
- Contribute to architecture design, technical proposals, and long-term research directions.
requirements:
Minimum Qualifications
- B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields; or Ph.D. with strong research/publications.
- 5+ years of relevant industry experience (exception for Ph.D. with strong background).
- Proficiency in C/C++ development and debugging.
- Strong Linux systems development experience.
- Solid understanding of compute, network architecture, and operating systems.
- Background in at least one of: software-hardware co-design, distributed systems, high-performance networking, or AI/ML systems.

Preferred Qualifications
- Ph.D. in related fields with research training and publications.
- Experience with software-hardware co-design (networking, storage, or distributed compute).
- Hands-on experience with network virtualization (OVS, SR-IOV, eBPF).
- Familiarity with DPDK and high-performance user-space networking.
- Bonus points for hardware acceleration experience, FPGA/ASIC/GPU/CUDA
- Bonus points for experience with NCCL Collectives along with AI communication patterns and parallelization techniques
- Proven experience designing and building AI/ML infrastructure related but not limited to inference kv cache system, data preprocessing system.

团队介绍：抖音致力于打造一个开放、积极、多元、友善的平台，鼓励表达、沟通和记录，激发创造，丰富人们的精神世界，让现实生活更美好。我们通过AI算法驱动的个性化推荐与智能创作工具，满足用户表达、学习、娱乐、社交、消费等需求。回顾抖音一路走来的历程，我们在帮助亿万用户记录美好生活的过程中，努力变得更好。抖音社区治理团队负责抖音的社区治理工作，包括视频、直播等多体裁的内容治理，以及安全产品中台能力建设。

1、负责抖音账号风险治理，结合账号全生命周期表现和行为，识别各类账号风险问题，看清账号构成，并制定安全策略体系和解决方案，包括但不限于垃圾注册、账号团伙等；
2、设计合理的指标监控体系，通过用户反馈、数据监控、情报分析等方法优发掘账号风险问题，不断推动风险治理方案和策略体系的迭代，保障风险可控；
3、对接业务、标准、情报、算法和研发团队，建立跨团队/部门有效联动合作机制，能有效协同和推动风险问题的解决。
requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，计算机/信息安全/统计学/数学或相关专业优先，理工背景优先；
2、具有互联网产品相关工作经验，有账号风控、内容策略、大模型或相关领域经验者优先；
3、拥有良好的沟通能力，能够跨团队沟通，主动推动项目进展，取得预期结果；
4、数据导向，能够深度数据挖掘，能够从数据中找到问题本质并通过数据化手段解决问题；
5、具备自我驱动力，充满求知欲，能够在环境中独立工作，并愿意接受挑战，追求卓越。

1）Windows方向：
（a）深入理解Windows NT架构及底层运行机制，熟悉PE文件结构、内存管理、对象管理、进程/线程管理、异常分发、调试机制等核心原理，了解Win32窗口与消息机制、COM/DCOM/RPC/ALPC等系统通信与组件模型。
（b）熟练掌握常规注入与反注入（如消息钩子、远程线程、APC、输入法、LSP/NSP等）方案与工程落地能力，掌握主流Hook技术的原理与应用。
（c）熟悉Windows网络编程与网络管控机制，了解LSP、NSP、WFP、NDIS、TDI等常用网络框架，能够实现基于进程、协议、IP、端口、域名等维度的网络访问控制、链接拦截、放行与审计能力。
（d）熟悉Windows权限与安全边界机制，包括Access Token、Integrity Level、UAC、Job Object、AppContainer、PP/PPL等，理解隔离边界与适用范围，具备权限收敛、进程约束与沙箱加固实践经验。
（e）熟悉Windows文件系统与设备访问控制机制，理解NTFS权限模型、Minifilter、对象命名空间及句柄访问控制原理，支撑文件读写审计、敏感路径隔离、设备访问限制等安全能力建设；

（a）具备扎实的Linux系统编程基础，熟悉进程与线程模型、IPC、文件I/O、内存管理等核心机制，能够熟练使用GDB、strace、perf、valgrind等工具开展问题定位与性能分析。
（b）熟悉Linux底层安全机制，包括Seccomp、Landlock、Capabilities、Namespace、Cgroups、eBPF等，理解其设计原理、适用边界及工程化落地方式。
（c）深入理解Linux系统调用原理、glibc实现与动态链接机制，具备系统级拦截、运行时管控或沙箱研发经验。
（d）熟悉容器Runtime、安全容器、云原生安全、终端安全产品等相关技术体系，理解其核心机制，并具备相关方向研发或落地经验。
（e）了解KVM/QEMU虚拟化、云沙箱、Serverless容器、轻量级虚拟机等技术原理，有相关系统设计、能力建设或工程实践；

（b）具备macOS API Hook或Runtime Instrumentation经验，熟悉C/C++层符号Hook、dyld、Mach-O、动态链接以及Objective-C Runtime、Method Swizzling、IMP替换、消息转发等底层机制。
（c）熟悉macOS安全与权限体系，包括TCC、SIP、Sandbox、Hardened Runtime、Entitlement、XPC等，具备相关能力设计与工程落地经验。
（d）熟悉Endpoint Security、Network Extension系统扩展框架，能够支撑终端安全、行为监控与访问控制等场景建设。
（e）具备良好的系统分析、问题定位和工程落地能力。

title: 财务BP-云计算资源
responsibilities:

1）推动建立算力标签体系（Tagging），将云账单精准分摊至各业务线（如AI模型训练、短视频分发）；

1）监督云服务合同符合IFRS16等租赁准则，确保存储与计算服务的准确账务处理；
2）处理跨境结算中的预提税（WHT）和增值税风险。
requirements:
1、财务、会计、经济或数学相关专业本科及以上学历，5年以上财务经验，其中至少3年以上互联网基础设施、云计算或IDC财务BP背景；持有CPA、ACCA或CMA证书优先；

3、能够与架构师、技术进行深度对话，具备较强的逻辑拆解能力和跨部门影响力；愿意接受挑战。

title: Network Engineer, Physical Network Infrastructure
responsibilities:
About the Team
ByteDance Infrastructure Networking team brings together innovative ideas and technologies from network architecture, software-defined networking (SDN), network virtualization, switch software and hardware co-design, and high-speed networking, to create hyperscale data-center networking solutions that power several of the most popular apps of the world such as TikTok which serve hundreds of millions of users around the globe.

ByteDance Infrastructure Networking team is responsible for planning, building and operating the global, intelligent network infrastructure to meet the requirements of high availability, scalability, and high-performance. By joining this team, you will gain marketable network experience in multiple technological domains on a global scale.

- Plan, design, implement, operate and optimize ByteDance's global backbone network across all major continents.
- Collaborate with network architecture, SDN, tools platform teams to improve network scalability, resource utilization, buildout efficiency and operational excellence.

- Partner with the 7x24 NOC team to support the day-to-day operations of the global backbone network infrastructure, including responding to network incidents alerts, mitigation, and service restoration during network failures.

requirements:

- Bachelor's in Computer Science, Information Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- In-depth knowledge and skill of backbone traffic engineering technologies, such as RSVP-TE, SRTE-MPLS and SRv6 etc.

- Good understanding of controller-based software-defined networking.
- Programming/scripting in Python or other languages.

title: Partnership Development Analyst - AI Data and Safety
responsibilities:
Team Introduction
The AI Data and Safety team plays a critical role in advancing Seed foundational models across modalities and improving AI-native applications built on the Seed model series. We work across the data lifecycle, from defining evaluation approaches and translating user feedback and benchmark outcomes into data requests, to building scalable processes that improve data quality and support rapid model iteration.

Our team combines technical and operational capabilities, bringing together multidisciplinary talent across product management, data engineering, and data operations. Our work is driven by people who think deeply about model behavior, move quickly to solve complex problems, and bring first-hand experience as both builders and users of models and agents.

In close partnership with Seed researchers, industry experts, and leading data vendors, we tackle challenging data problems at the frontier of AI development, helping improve both model performance and user experience.

AI Data & Safety - External Partnership Development Team is dedicated to continuously sourcing high-quality data suppliers for foundation models and AI-native applications. Based on the data requirements of model training, the team conducts market research and manages the end-to-end process—from supplier sourcing and evaluation, commercial negotiations, and project initiation, to final delivery. By efficiently fulfilling data requests and building a robust supplier ecosystem, the team provides a reliable, high-quality data foundation for the continuous iteration of our models.

AI Training Data Market Research and Resource Development
1. Partner closely with AI model training teams to understand business needs, define data types, standards, and core requirements, and conduct structured industry and market research to stay abreast of AI data trends, market landscape, and technological advancements
2. Translate market insights into high-quality data resource development strategies by identifying and engaging startups and leading data suppliers; establish effective supplier evaluation and screening mechanisms; and expand and onboard suppliers to build a robust, high-quality data ecosystem
3. Conduct strategic analysis of market, supplier, and industry data to extract actionable insights; produce analytical reports to support decision-making in AI model training, data procurement, and business strategy
4. Continuously identify and monitor emerging data resources and potential partners, maintain strong market relationships, and ensure access to forward-looking, high-quality data sources

Supplier Onboarding, Delivery, and Lifecycle Management
1. Lead supplier onboarding, including evaluation, qualification review, and capability validation, ensuring alignment with project delivery standards and seamless integration into internal workflows
2. Manage end-to-end commercial engagements with suppliers, including contract negotiation, terms drafting, cost control, and compliance review, ensuring efficient and compliant partnerships while optimising commercial terms
3. Oversee supplier delivery across projects by coordinating internal and external stakeholders, clarifying requirements (even in ambiguous scenarios), managing expectations, and ensuring timely, high-quality data delivery aligned with project goals
4. Maintain and develop long-term supplier relationships; regularly evaluate supplier performance and service quality; optimise supplier management frameworks; and leverage data analysis to generate insights and improve supplier performance and collaboration value
requirements:
Minimum Qualifications
1. Bachelor’s degree or above in Marketing, Business Management, Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or related fields; candidates with relevant AI data industry internship or project experience will also be considered.
2. At least 2 years of relevant experience in AI data services, data sourcing, supplier/vendor management, or business development. 
3. Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to independently conduct market research, synthesise insights, and solve complex problems.
4. Proven ability in supplier sourcing and channel development, with strong business acumen and the ability to identify and match high-quality resources to business needs.
5. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex and ambiguous situations across multiple stakeholders.
6. Basic project management capabilities, with the ability to plan, execute, and monitor supplier onboarding and delivery processes, ensuring timelines, quality, and risk control; strong data analysis and reporting skills, with the ability to derive insights and drive process improvements

The Macro Research team operates as ByteDance's internal knowledge and advisory function, conducting rigorous research on economic and philosophical studies, geopolitics, technology governance, international affairs and history. The team tracks macro trends, produces long-horizon strategic assessments, and provides deep, contextualized insights to senior leadership on the global environment in which the company operates. Our work informs executive decision-making on market expansion, regulatory preparedness, and strategic positioning.

Responsibilities:

Preferred Qualifications:

- Prior experience at a major research institution, think tank (e.g., RAND, Brookings, CSIS, CFR, Chatham House), tier one University, strategic consultancy, or in-house strategic corporate intelligence function

团队介绍：Ads Core 是抖音集团广告业务体系中负责交易机制与智能决策的核心技术团队之一。
 
我们面对的是一个超大规模的商业化经济系统：一端是广告主和商家，希望在可控成本下获得订单、GMV、线索、用户增长和长期生意增长；另一端是抖音等产品中有限而高价值的用户流量。Ads Core 要解决的问题，是预算从哪里来、流量给到哪里，以及如何让每一次商业流量分配都更接近客户增量、用户体验和平台长期收入的共同最优。
 
团队覆盖出价与竞价、归因与信号、自动化投放、流量机制、激励增长等关键方向，通过机器学习、因果推断、强化学习、机制设计和大规模工程系统，把客户经营目标转化为平台可理解、可执行、可优化的交易决策。
 
技术上，Ads Core 处在超大规模、高并发、强约束的真实交易系统中。我们需要在每天海量请求里完成预算分配、实时出价、归因度量、自动化决策和流量机制优化；也需要在客户目标、用户体验和平台长期收入之间做多目标建模与系统决策。这里会持续产生因果归因、强化学习、机制设计、长期价值建模、大规模在线实验、实时工程系统等高难度问题，并要求算法能力真正落到线上交易链路和业务结果中。
 
加入 Ads Core，你将参与建设抖音集团广告业务最核心的底层系统：让广告主真正把生意做大，让用户体验持续被保护，让平台获得长期、合理、可持续的商业化收入。如果你希望在真实商业系统里把算法、机制和工程能力转化为可见的业务影响，这里会提供足够复杂、也足够有成长空间的问题。

1、参与抖音、今日头条、番茄小说等亿级用户规模产品的变现、增长工作，聚焦流量优化、激励补贴以及长期价值建模，实现广告营收的提升以及用户留存的优化；
2、运用深度学习、强化学习、因果推断、运筹优化、Policy Learning等技术提升个性化激励准确度，通过算法建模实现激励与流量的高效协同，落地前沿研究成果，持续推动字节跳动用户的LTV提升；
3、在超大规模深度学习框架下，参与模型、出价以及策略迭代，持续深入优化激励场景的CTR/CVR/Uplift模型，探索激励在广告与营销场景的业界最佳实践。

title: AI训练数据与评测专家 - AI数据与安全
responsibilities:
团队介绍：AI 数据与安全团队为 Seed 基座模型及 AI 原生应用提供跨模态数据服务，覆盖数据生产全流程，包含模型评估标准的制定、数据规模化生产、数据飞轮搭建，不断提升数据质量，支持模型快速迭代。
团队由产品经理、数据工程、数据运营等跨职能人才组成，并通过与 Seed 研究员、行业专家、全球顶尖数据供应商紧密合作，从真实场景中收集反馈并分析模型表现数据，解决 AI 前沿突破过程中的复杂数据问题，推动模型性能与用户体验的双重提升。我们既是帮助模型技术迭代的一线贡献者，也是模型和 AI 产品的一手用户。

1、负责大语言模型在通用能力、生产力、多模态&世界模型、Coding&Agent等场景下的训练数据建设与模型评测工作，支持SFT、RL、偏好数据及专项能力数据的生产和迭代，深入理解不同业务场景及用户需求，设计训练数据方案和评估方案，包括数据挖掘、数据构造、清洗去重、标注规范制定、质量验收及评估集建设，分析训练数据的分布、覆盖度、多样性及质量问题，识别数据偏差、能力缺口和长尾场景，持续优化数据配比、生产策略和质量标准；
2、基于大语言模型的调用链路、检索结果、工具调用、模型回复及中间过程等信息，开展负面案例分析、错误定位与根因归类，判断问题来源于训练数据、模型能力、策略、检索或工程链路，结合模型实验结果，分析不同数据批次、数据类型及训练策略对模型效果的影响，闭环验证数据有效性，推动训练数据持续迭代；
3、设计并完善训练数据和模型评测的自动化流程，包括数据预处理、Prompt设计、数据合成、自动化打标、质量检查、结果聚类及分析报告生成等，提升数据生产和评估效率；
4、作为项目POC，与算法、产品、策略及数据团队紧密协作，负责需求澄清、方案设计、项目排期、资源协调、质量验收、风险管理及结果交付；
5、沉淀训练数据方法论、评估框架、错误分类体系、质量Rubric、项目SOP及分析模板，推动数据能力、评估标准和自动化工具复用。
requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，计算机、人工智能、数据科学、统计学、数学、语言学等相关专业优先，具备经济、金融、法律、医疗、教育等垂直行业背景者更佳，这类背景有助于更深入理解复杂专业场景下的数据生产与评测需求；
2、对大模型、AI应用、数据生产或模型评测有浓厚兴趣，愿意深入理解业务场景并推动问题解决；
3、具备良好的逻辑分析能力、结构化表达能力和跨团队沟通协作能力，能够把复杂问题拆解清楚并推动落地；
4、具备较强的AI意识，习惯将AI工具融入日常工作与学习，能够主动探索AI能力边界，并在实际场景中推动应用落地者优先；
5、具备较强的责任心、自驱力和学习能力，愿意在不确定性的发展环境中保持平常心，主动推动事情往前走，具备较强的适应能力；
6、有大模型、AIGC、多模态、Agent、代码生成、搜索问答等相关科研、竞赛或项目经历者优先。

3、数据治理与告警运营：参与日志标准化、字段治理、数据质量监控、告警去重、聚合、抑制、富化流程设计，结合CTI、资产、身份、漏洞、业务标签和历史事件上下文，提高告警可解释性和有效案例转化率；
4、检测质量与工程化：建立检测规则的测试、回放、灰度发布、效果评估和回归验证机制，推动Detection-as-Code和CI/CD检测发布流程，跟踪真实攻击、红队演练、事件复盘和误报反馈，持续优化检测覆盖和质量，输出检测工程文档、事件复盘结论、检测覆盖矩阵和运营指标，推动检测能力沉淀为团队资产；

requirements:
1、具备3年以上安全运营、检测工程、威胁狩猎、SIEM内容开发、蓝队或安全数据分析经验；
2、熟悉至少一种主流查询或检测语言，例如KQL、SPL、SQL、Sigma、YARA、EQL、Lucene等，具备基础数据工程意识，理解日志Schema、字段标准化、数据延迟、数据缺失、去重聚合和数据质量对检测效果的影响；
3、理解常见攻击链和ATT&CK技术，包括身份攻击、横向移动、权限提升、命令执行、持久化、数据外传、云控制面滥用等，能够把攻击行为拆解为可观测信号，并判断所需日志、字段、上下文和检测边界；
4、熟悉终端、身份、网络、云、邮件、Web、SaaS等至少两个以上安全数据域；
5、熟悉检测生命周期管理，包括规则评审、版本控制、测试验证、上线发布、效果度量和持续优化，具备较强的误报分析、检测调优、证据链构建和事件研判能力；
6、对AI在安全运营中的应用有理解，能够清楚区分AI预研判、自动化建议和高风险响应动作的人审边界。

加分项
1、有Detection-as-Code、Sigma规则库、SIEM内容工程化或CI/CD检测发布经验；
2、有ClickHouse、Kafka、Elastic、Splunk、Sentinel、Chronicle、Snowflake等安全数据平台经验；

4、熟悉OpenCTI、MISP、TheHive、DFIR-IRIS、SOAR或案例management工作流；
5、有LLM、RAG、Agent、MCP、AI应用安全或AI SOC相关实践经验；

title: Partner Sales Manager - Lark APAC - HCMC
responsibilities:
About the Team：
We are the driving force behind Lark's expansion in the APAC market. Our focus is on helping businesses embrace digital transformation through our collaboration solutions, and we're dedicated to identifying and seizing market opportunities while acquiring new customers to foster growth.
As a Partner Sales Manager under our Sales team in Lark APAC, you will help to acquire and enable new partners, construct business plans, ensure partner success and foster mutually beneficial relationships in alignment with Lark APAC's business strategy.
Join us if you're ready to be a part of this exciting journey and to make a tangible impact on business growth!

As a Strategic Partnership Manager under our Strategic Partnerships team in Lark APAC, you will help to construct business plans, ensure partner success and foster mutually beneficial relationships in alignment with Lark APAC's business strategy.

Job Responsibilities:
- You will work on strategy planning with your partners. You will need to closely collaborate with your partners to develop and enhance their strategy in alignment with Lark's GTM approach. Ensuring they focus on the appropriate target audience and employ the correct methodology.
- You will collaborate with acquired partners to construct business plans that align with Lark's overall business strategy and objectives, while ensuring that partner plans contribute to mutual growth and success.
- You will be involved in enablement and monitoring the partners' sales: You will work closely with the partner enablement manager to monitor the progress of partners' sales and pitching capabilities, and determine if any actions or interventions are needed.
- You will be responsible for sourcing, outreaching, and qualifying potential partners in target markets from time to time, ensuring a robust pipeline of partners. You will also execute strategies to acquire partners that align with Lark's business objectives.
- You will act as a main point of contact for partner-related operational matters; supporting partner operations by addressing partner inquiries, providing necessary information, and ensuring smooth collaboration.
- You will act as the primary interface between Lark and Partners' marketing teams, fostering collaboration and alignment of marketing strategies. Work jointly on marketing initiatives that enhance the visibility and success of both parties.
- You will strive to grow partners' pipelines by actively monitoring pipeline performance and identifying areas of improvement
requirements:
Minimum Qualifications:
- You fully understand how partners operate in a SaaS model. Your track record includes proven experience in channel partner management, business development, or sales, preferably in the technology industry.
- You are a strategic thinker. You possess the ability to analyze data, identify trends, and develop actionable insights to drive business growth.
- You are a results-driven achiever. You exhibit a results-oriented mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and KPIs.
- You have a customer-focused mindset. You demonstrate strong commitment to customer satisfaction and partner success, with a focus on delivering value and driving long-term relationships. You have the ability to build rapport, negotiate effectively, and influence stakeholders at all levels.
- You thrive in a fast-paced environment. You excel in the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Ideally, you come with some proven experience in successfully sourcing, reaching out to, and acquiring strategic partners in the APAC region.
- You have prior experience showcasing your adaptability and an entrepreneurial mindset.
- You embrace willingness to travel as needed to meet with partners, attend industry events, and support business activities.

5、具备较强的负责人意识、自驱力和跨团队协作能力，能够与产品、研发、算法、运营等角色高效合作，推动复杂问题闭环。

title: Agent自进化算法工程师-AI Platform
responsibilities:

4、与评测平台、Trace分析平台产品团队紧密协作，将上述闭环能力产品化，降低业务接入成本，提升自进化方法的通用性与可迁移性。
requirements:
1、人工智能、计算机科学、统计学、软件工程等相关专业研究生及以上学历，具备扎实的工程与算法基础；

title: Technology Internal Audit Lead
responsibilities:
Internal Audit is a global function responsible for providing independent assurance and evaluating the company's risk management, governance and internal control processes to determine if they are designed and operating effectively. The Internal Audit team plans and executes audit projects according to our risk-based audit plan by evaluating  operational, compliance, IT, and financial processes and controls. We work with business functions in addressing risks and improving the control environment through timely and comprehensive audit work and tracking of remediation actions until completion. 

Position Summary:
We are looking for an experienced Technology Internal Audit Lead to join the Global Technology Audit team. The role will primarily support TikTok and other products operating outside China and will be responsible for leading technology audits and risk reviews. The individual will be part of the Global Technology Audit team and innovative assurance methods to impact and influence positive business outcomes across products such as TikTok, TikTok Shop and Dola. 

Responsibilities:
- Technology Audit Delivery: Lead planning and execution of technology audit programs and complex technology control assessments: Products powered by LLMs, Information Security, Infrastructure, Privacy. Assess technical architectures for AI/ML systems, focusing on data flow, model training & fine-tuning processes, model serving infrastructure, and integration with downstream applications.
- Advanced Data Analytics: Leverage data analytics to detect risk signals and unearth insights for AI/ML models. Review controls for data quality, privacy, security, access management, safety testing, hallucination mitigation, evaluation metrics, red-teaming procedures, and output monitoring. 
- Technology Risk Assessment: Develop practical, risk-based recommendations that address root causes while considering product, engineering, regulatory, and business requirements. Ability to grasp complex, home grown technology stack, comfortable speaking with engineers and product teams. 
- Stakeholder Relationships: Develop and maintain collaborative working relationships with management, understand the business to provide value-added services, and establish credibility as a management consultant and internal controls resource. Partner with engineering and product teams to advise on design and implementation of technology solutions.
- Quality Assurance: Ensure the overall quality and consistency of audit work, adhering to department and professional standards. Continuously seek opportunities for audit process improvement.
requirements:
Minimum Qualification(s):
- Minimally 5 years of relevant work experience in Technology Audits, Product Security, Security Engineering or Security Compliance, and/or consulting; proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a product-centric culture.
- Strong understanding of security fundamentals across various cyber domains: IAM, applied cryptography, key management systems, data security, application security, web security, security protocols, API Design, threat intelligence, network security, hardware security, vulnerability management, etc.
- Proven analytical ability to assess complex technology environments against risk assessment outcomes, industry best practices, internal standards and external regulatory requirements.
- Excellent problem solving, critical thinking, collaboration and communication skills combined with the ability to provide a credible technical challenge to the business.

Preferred Qualification(s):
- Relevant work experience preferably within the technology sector (Social Media, Content Management, FinTech etc.)
- Deep understanding of LLMs, ML pipelines, model lifecycle management, and data engineering architectures.
- Experience working in a fast-paced, global technology company or rapidly scaling environment across different time zones.
- Solid background and experience working with one or more of the following areas: LLMs or ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace); common application and infrastructure security vulnerabilities and mitigations (OWASP Top 10, CWE 25); source code and DevOps management tools (e.g., Github, Bitbucket); or SaaS and IaaS cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
- Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, CCNA, CISA, CRISC, or CIA.
- Be able to handle ambiguity and collaborate with a global team.
- Passion for emerging technologies, products and standards.

1、负责对番茄小说产品网文书壳、搜索推荐场景下的内容治理，在标准、流程机制、工具策略等方面推进产品优化，降低风险并提升用户体验；
2、对风险类型能够梳理出清晰特征、推进安全标准刻画，针对专项及管控节点梳理治理方案并推进落实，不断优化完善风险内容质量治理体系，平衡用户体验；
3、建立网文书壳、搜索推荐词安全相关目标及治理体系，做好指标的交付跟踪，包括但不限于策略和标准运营及优化、治理方向等；
4、与运营、产品研发、人审等协作方建立良好合作，共识需求，明确协作分工，共同助力目标达成。
requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，具备良好的敏感安全意识，内容安全策略运营领域专业知识扎实；
2、有信息内容质量把控基础，可以准确识别基础的违规风险，明确违规类型及对应判罚尺度；
3、对于网文或者安全治理策略有所了解，有一定内容安全策略运营工作经验基础，有从外部审视产品潜在风险以及内容安全的能力；
4、具备较强的运营能力，执行力强，具备一定的逻辑思维能力及开放的沟通合作意识，能清晰地沟通和表达想法。

3、责任心强，能适应值班岗工作；
4、对优质内容有感知，能快速识别内容的基础错误、信息漏洞、违规内容，做事细心、耐心、不敷衍。

title: Engine & SDK Tech Lead
responsibilities:
Team Description
The PICO Developer Technology team is at the forefront of XR innovation, building next-generation developer-facing technologies that push the boundaries of what is possible in spatial computing. We work on all aspects of the software stack — from low-level runtime systems and game engine integrations to developer SDKs that empower creators to build the most immersive XR & Spatial applications. If you are passionate about shaping the future of interactive 3D graphics and want to work on cutting-edge technology that reaches millions, this is your playground.

We are seeking a visionary technical leader with deep expertise in game engines, real-time 3D graphics, and SDK architecture to drive innovation in XR. This is not a maintenance role — you will explore, research, and build the next generation of graphics and developer technologies that define the future of spatial computing. You will work at the intersection of game engine architecture, advanced rendering, and XR runtime systems, pushing the limits of what is possible on mobile XR hardware.

Responsibilities
- Lead the technical vision and architecture for next-generation game engine, graphics, and SDK features in XR
- Drive cutting-edge graphics research and innovation — advanced rendering techniques, performance optimizations, and novel XR-specific rendering pipelines
- Architect and evolve developer SDKs that enable external creators to build best-in-class XR experiences
- Collaborate with OS, Engine, Product, and Hardware teams to deliver seamless end-to-end XR experiences, with obsessive focus on performance, latency, and visual quality
- Explore and prototype emerging technologies — ray tracing, foveated rendering, neural graphics, eye/face tracking integration, and beyond
- Mentor and grow a team of strong graphics and engine engineers, setting technical direction and raising the bar
requirements:
Minimum Qualifications
- Hands-on experience in game engine development, 3D graphics, or rendering systems, with a proven track record of shipping high-performance graphics features
- Deep expertise in modern rendering pipelines, shader programming (HLSL/GLSL/SPIR-V), and graphics APIs (Vulkan, Direct3D, Metal, or OpenGL ES)
- Advanced proficiency in C/C++ and low-level systems programming, with a strong sense of performance and memory
- Strong foundational knowledge of game engine architecture — rendering, physics, input, animation, and asset pipelines
- Solid understanding of modern mobile or console graphics pipelines and hardware constraints

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience designing and building developer-facing SDKs, APIs, or frameworks
- Prior experience in AR/VR/MR development, XR runtime infrastructure, or spatial computing
- Expertise in advanced rendering techniques: 3DGS, neural rendering, real-time ray tracing 
- Background in game engine development (Unreal, Unity, or custom engines), especially in graphics or low-latency input pipelines
- Experience with compute shaders, GPU-driven rendering, or heterogeneous computing
- Familiarity with native Android development, including Android Services, IPC, and NDK
- Open-source contributions or published work in graphics, engines, or related fields

title: Senior Compliance Expert, Vietnam - Global Payment
responsibilities:
About the Team
In line with ByteDance's globalization plans, there has been an increasing demand for payment services and financial services such as BNPL to: (1) enhance and support our current business needs; and (2) increase our service offerings to the end user. As such, the need for payment services has gradually increased in our overseas business development strategy. Whether it's paying money to creators/users to encourage user growth, or offering paid services to users, payments have become an important step in our integrated service offerings.
 
About the role
We are looking for a Senior Compliance Expert to own the compliance function for GP's Vietnam business, with a particular focus on our P2P lending sandbox entity and adjacent payment and lending products. A significant part of the mandate is to advise on and lead compliance workstream in partnership projects with credit institutions in Vietnam and other licensed partners, through which GP delivers financial services to users in Vietnam: shaping the structure so it holds up against applicable licensing perimeter, negotiating the compliance and AML/CFT terms, and carrying the workstream from structuring through regulatory approval to launch.

This is not a policy-drafting seat. Delivery for Vietnam depends on product, engineering, operations, risk, legal and finance teams sitting in regional and global functions, none of whom report into this role, alongside external counterparties including credit institutions and intermediary payment service providers. The role is accountable for driving all of them to a single regulatory outcome: defining clearly what the regulator and the approved dossier require, securing commitment from the teams who own delivery, and verifying that what goes live matches what was approved. We are therefore looking for someone whose track record is built on coordination and execution, not only on advisory work.

This role will be based onsite at our office and will require a 5-day onsite work arrangement.

Responsibilities
Licensing execution & cross-functional coordination
- Act as single accountable owner for the Vietnam regulatory workstream, drive delivery through regional and global product, engineering, operations, risk, legal and finance teams.
- Make regulatory requirements legible and actionable to teams, and make the case for prioritisation against competing market demands.
- Primary compliance interface with the licensing partners, State Bank of Vietnam and other authorities.
- Lead compliance workstreams on license applications, sandbox admissions, renewals and variations, including dossier preparation, regulator Q&A cycles, and remediation of conditions.
- Own the regulatory approval path for each partnership, including filings, notifications or no-objection steps required before go-live.

Partnership with credit institutions
- Lead the compliance workstream on partnership projects with credit institutions and licensed partners in Vietnam.
- Act as primary compliance advisor to the business: answer interpretation questions, review proposed commercial terms and product flows and advise on viable options.
- Assess proposed structures against the licensing perimeter and applicable lending, payment and data requirements.
- Conduct documented regulatory risk assessment for each partnership, covering licensing, AML/CFT, consumer protection, data protection and outsourcing risk.
- Escalate where residual risk exceeds the agreed appetite, where a structure requires a position that is untested with the regulator, or where a partner or internal team cannot meet a control commitment.

AML/CFT and MLRO duties
- Own the AML/CFT programme end to end: risk assessment and EWRA, customer due diligence and enhanced due diligence, sanctions and PEP screening, transaction monitoring, alert investigation, and suspicious transaction reporting.
- Discharge MLRO statutory duties for the P2P entity, including filings with the authority, and act as the entity's POC on financial crime matters.

Governance and BAU
- Develop, maintain and adapt compliance policies, procedures and control standards.
- Track regulatory developments affecting lending, payments and data, assess business impact, and drive required changes.
- Manage regulatory examinations, internal audits and group compliance reviews, including remediation tracking.
- Build and maintain the Vietnam obligations register and compliance monitoring plan.
- Translate regulatory requirements and dossier commitments into clear, written implementation requirements that product, engineering and operations teams can build against: customer onboarding and eKYC flows, disbursement and collection flows, transaction monitoring rules, record keeping, disclosures and consent architecture.
- Issue guidance and answer interpretation questions from delivery teams throughout the build.
- Review and sign off on solution designs, UAT scenarios and control test results prepared by the owning teams.
requirements:
Minimum qualifications
- Law degree with 5+ years in legal, compliance or regulatory roles, including time owning a workstream. Law firm, in-house, or a mix.
- Track record of taking a regulated project or transaction from documentation through to completion, with concrete examples of where it stalled and how it was unblocked.
- Proven ability to coordinate partners and internal functions, and to secure firm commitments from stakeholders who do not report to you.
- Ability to turn regulatory requirements into clear written specifications for non-legal delivery teams, and to review their output critically.
- Working knowledge of AML/CFT and the ability to own the programme end to end, including CDD, screening, transaction monitoring and STR filing.
- Experience owning written engagement with a Vietnamese authority, including submissions and Q&A cycles.
- Strong analytical and drafting skills, and the judgement to escalate rather than absorb.

Preferred qualifications
- Knowledge of lending and payments regulation in Vietnam: P2P sandbox, non-cash payment and intermediary payment services, credit institution requirements, personal data protection.
- Experience at a P2P platform, consumer finance company, bank, e-wallet or IPS provider in Vietnam.
- Experience at a financial regulator or supervisory authority.
- Exposure to BNPL, embedded lending, or multi-party white-label structures.
- Experience in a cross-border organisation where compliance decisions sit partly outside the local market.

title: APAC Accounting Lead (Accounting & Reporting)

We are looking for an APAC Accounting Lead based in Singapore to support the accounting and financial reporting activities of the Group's APAC entities. - Basic knowledge of tax requirements and regulatory compliance across SEA countries.

title: Mexico - AI Creator Operation & Partnership Manager - CapCut
responsibilities:
Team Introduction:
CapCut is an all-in-one video editing app that empowers creators to express themselves and transform videos into creative masterpieces. In addition to its basic features, such as video editing, text, stickers, filters, colors and music, CapCut offers free advanced features, including keyframe animation, smooth slow-motion effects, chroma key, Picture-in-Picture (PIP), and stabilization to help you capture and snip moments.

About the role:
CapCut is seeking a LATAM AI Creator & Event Operations Manager to lead AI-focused event operations and marketing initiatives across Latin America. This role will be responsible for building and scaling CapCut’s AI creator ecosystem, accumulating brand and industry resources, and partnering with regional marketing teams to execute high-impact AIGC creative campaigns. The ideal candidate will help position CapCut as a leading AI creative tool in the LATAM market by increasing the scale, activity, and retention of high-quality AI creators, while driving industry influence and user mindshare through innovative AI content and events.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and execute a systematic marketing strategy for CapCut’s AI event ecosystem in LATAM, building CapCut’s own branded AI creative event IPs and campaigns.
- Partner closely with product teams to design and optimize event mechanisms, workflows, and participation experiences that continuously attract high-quality AI creators.
- Collaborate with regional marketing and LATAM teams to cultivate relationships with leading brands, agencies, creator communities, and industry partners, and execute influential AIGC creative events.
- Identify, recruit, and manage high-potential AI creators across LATAM, designing long-term engagement and incentive programs to improve creator retention and showcase output.
- Plan and launch benchmark AI creator campaigns and case studies that amplify CapCut’s brand awareness, product influence, and AI market positioning.
- Monitor campaign and creator performance, analyze data and user feedback, and continuously optimize event operations and creator growth strategies.
requirements:
Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree or above, with 3+ years of experience in content marketing, event operations, creator/influencer operations, or related fields.
- Familiarity with AI image or video creation tools, and an existing network of AIGC creators/resources is mandatory.
- Strong understanding of the LATAM marketing landscape and major global social media platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and X.
- Proven ability in campaign planning, creative event ideation, data analysis, and cross-functional project management.
- Fluent in English, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural, and cross-border team environment.

title: Edge Network Engineer - EDGE Networking
responsibilities:
About the Team 
ByteDance Edge Networking is a global team, bringing together innovative ideas and technologies from network architecture, intent-based networking, network virtualization, switch software and hardware co-design, and high-speed networking, to create hyperscale Internet Edge networking solutions that power several of the most popular apps in the world, such as TikTok, Capcut etc., which serve hundreds of millions of users around the globe. 
ByteDance Edge Networking Team is responsible for designing, building, and operating the global, intelligent edge network infrastructure to meet the requirements of high availability, scalability, and high-performance. By joining this team, you will gain marketable software development and/or network operation experience in Internet Edge networking at massive scale. 

Responsibilities:  
- Design, build, operate, and optimize ByteDance's global Internet Edge networks.
- Work with cross-functional teams including but not limited to compute, storage, database, recommendation system, drive the innovation and evolution of ByteDance network.
- Work with external vendors and ISPs for device and carrier selection, perform testing and verification.
- Travel may be required up to 15% - 30% of the time.
requirements:
Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor's in Computer Science, Information Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or experience equivalent to a Bachelor's degree based on three or more years of work experience
- Good understanding of network protocols including TCP/IP, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS and MPLS etc.
- Good understanding of network monitoring protocols and tools, such as SNMP, Sflow/netflow, Telemetry.
- Familiar with data center network architecture, such as CLOS.
- Hands-on experience with major network devices, such as Arista, Cisco, Juniper, H3C, Huawei and other mainstream vendors.
- Self-motivated team player, good communication and written skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- In-depth knowledge of network protocols, implementation and operation in large scale Internet Peering networks. Solid skill sets in IPT/PNI/IX peering, PoP buildout, Internet routing security etc
- In-depth knowledge of network protocols and implementation in hyper scale data center networks.
- In-depth knowledge of MPLS related Traffic Engineering solutions, such as SRTE, RSVP, and LDP etc.
- Good understanding of IPv6 and IPv4-IPv6 co-existence technologies.
- Familiar with mainstream commercial switch/router chipsets, such as Broadcom, Barefoot etc.
- Network related automation skills based on Python, Linux scripting or other languages.
- CCIE/CCDE/JNCIE equivalent network certifications is a plus.

title: Electrical Engineer, Data Center Engineering
responsibilities:
About the Team
As the core nerve center of data centers, the power distribution system serves as the power source supporting full-site operation, while ELV control acts as the neural hub ensuring intelligent operation.

The Electrical Team takes full responsibility for the technical architecture, management, and continuous innovation of both power supply and ELV control systems throughout the entire lifecycle of data centers. With our professional technical capabilities, we develop highly reliable, secure, efficient, stable, green and low-carbon power supply, distribution and intelligent control infrastructure for data centers worldwide, enabling rapid business rollout and sustained, stable operation.

Key Responsibilities
1. Take charge of the electrical design, as well as the review and evaluation of technical solutions for new-build and renovated data centers. In accordance with business requirements, guide design institutes to complete architectural layout, scheme and construction drawing design by integrating the architecture and technical characteristics of various systems including medium & low voltage power systems, UPS systems, diesel generator systems, etc.
2. Conduct electrical design and technical management for external parties (cooperating design institutes, etc.) and internal departments (other collaborating teams, etc.); review construction drawings and special technical proposals submitted by suppliers and exercise full quality control.
3. Compile discipline-specific documents including design briefs, drawing review checklists & key review points, construction technical specifications and other relevant materials.
4. Manage quality control of electrical equipment for data center infrastructure, including summarizing defects identified during factory acceptance tests of equipment and following up on rectification implementation.
5. Provide on-site electrical design technical support throughout project construction, review design alterations, and coordinate acceptance of all electrical-related works and equipment across all project phases.
6. Deliver discipline-specific technical support during the operational phase of projects, organize technical reviews with the operation team, and update design technical specifications accordingly.
7. Support troubleshooting of in-service equipment, covering root cause analysis, formulation of improvement plans, and follow-up to ensure full implementation of corrective measures.
requirements:
Minimum Qualifications
1. Bachelor’s degree or above, major in Electrical Engineering and Automation or related disciplines; with at least 5 years of experience in electrical technical design for data centers. 
2. Have led and participated in electrical system design of data center projects as a project leader or discipline lead.
3. Proficient in the design, type selection and key performance optimization of equipment including generator, power distribution cabinets, transformers, UPS, batteries, PDUs, etc.
4. Familiar with industry specifications for electrical disciplines applicable to data centers, as well as cross-discipline coordination procedures throughout the whole project design cycle.
5. Strong knowledge of relevant standards for the design and testing of power distribution products, with the ability to develop test plans, oversee test execution, analyze test results, and a solid understanding of the manufacturing processes of power distribution equipment.
6. Have a clear grasp of construction costs, mainstream core technologies and operation models of electrical disciplines; able to provide design support for engineering, bidding and procurement teams, and understand operation & maintenance requirements of electrical systems.
7. Possess self-motivation and learning ability, with outstanding communication, organization, coordination and project delivery capabilities.

Preferred Qualification
- Experience working with third-party IDC operators is highly preferred.

title: Senior Software Engineer / Researcher, AI-Native database systems
responsibilities:
About the Team
Join ByteDance’s database R&D team, where you’ll build and own cutting-edge database products supporting Bytedance’s global infrastructure. Our diverse portfolio includes relational databases, distributed caches, key-value stores, document databases, graph databases, wide-column stores, search engines, and multi-model databases. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to enhance these services in a cloud-native environment, embracing a culture of intellectual curiosity, self-direction, and problem-solving. 

We are building the next-generation AI-native database systems—intelligent, multimodal, and designed for the era of large models. Our systems are not just data stores; they’re reasoning engines, retrieval platforms, and real-time memory for AI agents. As a Senior Software Engineer or Researcher, you will be at the forefront of rethinking how databases work when built from the ground up for AI workloads. You’ll help create infrastructure that powers intelligent systems across TikTok, CapCut, and future applications that haven’t been imagined yet.

Responsibilities
- Architect and implement AI-native databases that seamlessly integrate structured, unstructured, and vectorized data.
- Design storage engines optimized for embedding ingestion, multimodal retrieval, and real-time AI interaction.
- Build scalable and distributed vector search systems  with low-latency guarantees.
- Develop AI-augmented query processors that leverage large language models (LLMs) for semantic parsing, intent understanding, and cost estimation.
- Collaborate on developing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) infrastructure and LLM agent memory backends.
- Drive innovations in learned index structures, self-optimizing databases, and AI-integrated transaction systems.
- Publish and contribute to broader research and open-source communities.
requirements:
Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or related fields with strong systems or AI research experience.
- 2+ years in core database systems, large-scale distributed infrastructure, or machine learning systems.
- Strong coding and system-level design skills in C++ / Rust / Go.
- Deep expertise in one or more of the following areas: Storage engine architecture (LSM-trees, column stores, HTAP systems) / Vector retrieval systems, similarity search, and ANN indexing / AI infra or model-serving infrastructure (especially for embeddings / RAG / LLMs) / Semantic search, agent systems, or AI-native memory frameworks
- Ability to collaborate across research, engineering, and product teams to translate ideas into production systems.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with open-source systems such as Faiss, Milvus, DuckDB, ClickHouse, TiKV, RocksDB.
- Publications at accredited conferences (e.g., SIGMOD, VLDB, NeurIPS, MLSys, ICDE).
- Familiarity with GCP, AWS, or Azure’s database and AI integration strategies.
- Prior contributions to RAG, memory-augmented models, or self-tuning database components.
